slice_count_robustness.interpretation: descriptive robustness analysis; no causal or fairness claims

limitations: Slice-level pilot rather than complete study-level evaluation.

PPV, NPV, accuracy, and average precision depend on this enriched prevalence.

subgroup_robustness.interpretation: descriptive robustness analysis; subgroup comparisons are correlated and support no causal, biological, or fairness claims

limitations: Labels are report-derived and may contain label noise.
Only four selected findings are modeled.
High-sensitivity operating points have low specificity.
External and prospective validation have not been performed.

threshold_robustness.interpretation: operating-point sensitivity analysis; confidence intervals are wide and exam independence cannot be verified because patient identifiers are unavailable

limitations: The official validation partition is locked as the test set.
Patient identifiers are unavailable, so patient independence cannot be verified.
High-sensitivity operating points have low specificity.

system_limitations: This is a research demonstration and is not authorized for clinical use.
The system routes to separate modality-specific models; it does not perform cross-modality neural fusion.
Outputs and thresholds are not comparable across modalities.
The worklist urgency policy has not been prospectively clinically validated.
Synthetic smoke fixtures validate software behavior, not clinical performance.
